freeze_scope: synthetic conditional single-query NLL screening, not full sequence language modeling and not proof of capacity
hypothesis: K=4,T=1 orthogonal nonlinear Mirror causal mixing has at least 5% lower query NLL than strongest byte-near non-Mirror native/gain/rank1 control at matched train-compute proxy, in at least 2 of 3 fresh worlds and without greater than 10% regression on any of 3 causal tasks

tasks.copy: uniform 31-symbol prefix; last query encodes lag 1..8, output is prior token 0..31
tasks.retrieve: 16 unique key-value pair tokens (key 0..15, value 0..2); query addresses a key; last output is corresponding value
tasks.ordered: six noncommuting affine operators over Z3 followed by readout query; output is final state
tasks.hidden: uniform random unseen 0..2 target independent of observed random prefix; irreducible Bayes NLL log(3)

data.metric: last query target cross entropy (nats/example), NOT full sequence autoregressive NLL; accuracy
data.train_sample_stream: online CPU torch.Generator with seed world*11+seed*103+task_index*10101+1
data.input_encoding: torch.randperm(64) seeded by world; world permutation is not given to model

model.qkv: shared projections evaluated once per recurrent step for Mirror and scalar/rank1 controls
model.mirror: one learned orthogonal Givens angle repeated across each adjacent 2D channel plane; independent Q,K and nonlinear V-sandwich codes per logical head; exactly 3K trainable code scalars
model.view_aggregation: fixed arithmetic mean; no oracle labels, routing or learned per-example head selection

training.compute_match_budget_reference: mirror4 at 96 updates; floor(96*reference forward dense MAC proxy / model forward dense MAC proxy), at the same batch
training.budget_proxy_limitation: proxy dense MAC only; does NOT count rotation/trig/softmax/norm, hence it is not an exact hardware equal-FLOP match
training.development_rule: diagnostic check only; no tuning on fresh. If code/protocol is changed after freeze create a new protocol version and run new untouched fresh seeds

analysis.primary_ref: strongest of native,tied,gain4,rank1_4 (byte within 5% candidate) with matched MAC-proxy train budget
analysis.primary_gate: mean Mirror query NLL <=0.95 times strongest comparator on >=2/3 fresh worlds AND no causal task worse than 1.10 times comparator AND each causal task above token-local on mean
analysis.negative_gate: hidden target cannot be predicted; not to be counted as a Mirror advantage; absolute NLL near log(3), random accuracy approximately 1/3
analysis.status_when_undertrained: INCONCLUSIVE screening; do not reinterpret as global architecture failure
analysis.model_selection: no fresh tuning and no selective exclusion
analysis.error_reporting: all worlds, seeds and tasks reported; means plus paired differences; no CI claims from 3 worlds

storage_and_runtime.bytes: len(torch.save({config,state_dict})) on actual inference artifact (not optimizer)
storage_and_runtime.physical_params: unique learned scalar tensors (includes heads, norms and position encodings)
storage_and_runtime.virtual_projection_weights: 3*K*d*d logical QKV projections, not independent free params
storage_and_runtime.runtime: torch eager CPU FP32, torch.set_num_threads(1), train wall_s and batch8 forward ms per run
storage_and_runtime.training_mac_proxy: 3 * updates * batch * dense forward MAC; analytically estimated, not profiled exact FLOPs
storage_and_runtime.hardware: AMD EPYC 9V74 virtual 5-vCPU container, 5.8GiB RAM, CPU only, one PyTorch thread

falsification_and_limits: same QK orthogonal rotation is a null gauge; Q/K absolute angle counts may overcount identifiable relative degrees
unrestricted K head upper control is not byte matched
rank1_4 may exceed candidate bytes by ~2.3%
K full-width heads have extra attention memory and softmax cost even if dense MAC proxy matches
last-query classification does not test dense autoregressive sequence quality
3 world-specific lexical permutations are synthetic families and do not establish natural-task transfer
